title: OpenSpec change breakdown
description: The deliverables of one OpenSpec change and the dependencies among them. Lives at openspec/changes/<change>/breakdown.yaml.

schema_version.description: Version of this format. Readers refuse versions they do not support.

status.description: Deprecated. Approval is recorded per story by the plan workbench, never in this file. Read only to import approvals made before that.

repository.description: The repository every deliverable of this change lands in, by the name Sortie's workflow lists it under. A deliverable's own repository overrides it. Absent: the workflow's default repository.

approved_digest.description: Deprecated, with status: the digest of an approval made under the old format.

deliverable_ref.description: A deliverable id in the same change, or <change-name>/<id> for a deliverable in another change.

requirement_ref.description: <capability-path>#<requirement name>, as OpenSpec reports the change's requirements.

covers.description: Requirements this deliverable implements. Empty means the deliverable has no spec.

review.description: How the work is reviewed before it merges: human (a person merges the pull request) or criteria (a separate agent checks the acceptance criteria). Default human.

supersedes.description: The deliverable this one replaces, once that one has started. Its dependents move to this one.

repository.description: The repository this deliverable lands in, by the name Sortie's workflow lists it under; overrides the breakdown's repository.
